general.music: The user wants to control music or audio playback or edit volume settings actions such as mute, unmute, play, skip...
general.notes: The user wants to read, write, or manage personal notes
general.app: The user wants to open or close an application on their computer
general.search: The user wants to search for something on the internet
general.quit: The user wants to exit or quit the assistant

music.play: Play a specific song, artist, or resume playback
music.mute: Mute the volume without stopping the music
music.previous: Go back to the previous song
music.loop: Toggle looping the current song or playlist

notes.read: Read back or show the contents of a note

app.close: Close or quit a running application

search.search: Search the web for a topic, question, or piece of information
